name: CUDA Tile-and-Bin Implementation
definition: A CUDA pipeline partitioning the canvas into tiles and assigning primitives to tiles they overlap, using one thread block per tile for pixel-level parallelism.
summary: The CUDA Tile-and-Bin Implementation is a GPU parallelization strategy for 2D bitmap rendering that sets itself apart by explicitly managing tile-to-primitive assignment on the CPU and staging parameters in shared memory for cooperative compositing.
